description:
Record a payment for a document in Holded.

Args:
  - doc_type (string): Document type (required)
  - document_id (string): The document ID to pay (required)
  - amount (number): Payment amount (if different from document total)
  - account_id (string): Treasury/Bank account ID
  - date (number): Payment date as Unix timestamp

Returns:
  Confirmation of payment.

amount.description: Payment amount (if different from document total)

doc_type.description: Document type: invoice, salesreceipt, creditnote, receiptnote, estimate, salesorder, waybill, proform, purchase, purchaserefund, purchaseorder

name: holded_invoicing_pay_document
title: Pay Holded Document
